verses.textZh: 基督耶稣的仆人保罗和提摩太，写信给所有住在腓立比，在基督耶稣里的圣徒、监督和执事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督耶稣的仆人保罗和提摩太，写信给所有住在腓立比，在基督耶稣里的圣徒、监督和执事。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督耶稣的仆人保罗和提摩太写信给凡住腓立比、在基督耶稣里的众圣徒，和诸位监督，诸位执事。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all God’s holy people in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons :
verses.textEnEsv: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and deacons:
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul and Timothy, bondservants of Jesus Christ, To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul and Timothy, slaves of Christ Jesus. I am writing to all of God’s holy people in Philippi who belong to Christ Jesus, including the church leaders and deacons.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul and Timothy, bond-servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, including the overseers and deacons:
verses.textEn: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all God’s holy people in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons :

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恩惠、平安从神我们的父并主耶稣基督归与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 我每逢想到你们，就感谢我的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我每逢想到你们，就感谢我的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 我每逢想念你们，就感谢我的神；
verses.textEnNiv: I thank my God every time I remember you.
verses.textEnEsv: I thank my God in all my remembrance of you,
verses.textEnNkjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
verses.textEnNlt: Every time I think of you, I give thanks to my God.
verses.textEnNasb: I thank my God in all my remembrance of you,
verses.textEn: I thank my God every time I remember you.

verses.textZh: 每次为你们大家祈求的时候，总是欢欢喜喜地祈求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每次为你们大家祈求的时候，总是欢欢喜喜地祈求。
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢为你们众人祈求的时候，常是欢欢喜喜地祈求。
verses.textEnNiv: In all my prayers for all of you, I always pray with joy
verses.textEnEsv: always in every prayer of mine for you all making my prayer with joy,
verses.textEnNkjv: always in every prayer of mine making request for you all with joy,
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever I pray, I make my requests for all of you with joy,
verses.textEnNasb: always offering prayer with joy in my every prayer for you all,
verses.textEn: In all my prayers for all of you, I always pray with joy

verses.textZh: 为了你们从头一天直到现在都在福音的事工上有分，我就感谢我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了你们从头一天直到现在都在福音的事工上有分，我就感谢我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为从头一天直到如今，你们是同心合意地兴旺福音。
verses.textEnNiv: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
verses.textEnEsv: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now.
verses.textEnNkjv: for your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now,
verses.textEnNlt: for you have been my partners in spreading the Good News about Christ from the time you first heard it until now.
verses.textEnNasb: in view of your participation in the gospel from the first day until now.
verses.textEn: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,

verses.textZh: 我深信那在你们中间开始了美好工作的，到了基督耶稣的日子，必成全这工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我深信那在你们中间开始了美好工作的，到了基督耶稣的日子，必成全这工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 我深信那在你们心里动了善工的，必成全这工，直到耶稣基督的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And I am sure of this, that he who began a good work in you will bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: being confident of this very thing, that He who has begun a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ;
verses.textEnNlt: And I am certain that God, who began the good work within you, will continue his work until it is finally finished on the day when Christ Jesus returns.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am confident of this very thing, that He who began a good work among you will complete it by the day of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 为你们众人我有这样的思想是很恰当的，因为你们常常在我的心里，无论我是在捆锁之中，或是在辩护和证实福音的时候，你们都和我一同分享神的恩典。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为你们众人我有这样的思想是很恰当的，因为你们常常在我的心里，无论我是在捆锁之中，或是在辩护和证实福音的时候，你们都和我一同分享神的恩典。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为你们众人有这样的意念，原是应当的；因你们常在我心里，无论我是在捆锁之中，是辩明证实福音的时候，你们都与我一同得恩。
verses.textEnNiv: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart and, whether I am in chains or defending and confirming the gospel, all of you share in God’s grace with me.
verses.textEnEsv: It is right for me to feel this way about you all, because I hold you in my heart, for you are all partakers with me of grace, both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: just as it is right for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as both in my chains and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers with me of grace.
verses.textEnNlt: So it is right that I should feel as I do about all of you, for you have a special place in my heart. You share with me the special favor of God, both in my imprisonment and in defending and confirming the truth of the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is only right for me to feel this way about you all, because I have you in my heart, since both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers of grace with me.
verses.textEn: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart and, whether I am in chains or defending and confirming the gospel, all of you share in God’s grace with me.

verses.textZh: 我是怎样以基督耶稣的心肠，切切地想念你们众人，这是神可以为我作证的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是怎样以基督耶稣的心肠，切切地想念你们众人，这是神可以为我作证的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我体会基督耶稣的心肠，切切地想念你们众人；这是神可以给我作见证的。
verses.textEnNiv: God can testify how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: For God is my witness, how I yearn for you all with the affection of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God is my witness, how greatly I long for you all with the affection of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: God knows how much I love you and long for you with the tender compassion of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: For God is my witness, how I long for you all with the affection of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: God can testify how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 我所祷告的，是要你们的爱心，在充足的知识和各样的见识上，多而又多，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所祷告的，是要你们的爱心，在充足的知识和各样的见识上，多而又多，
verses.textZhCuv: 我所祷告的，就是要你们的爱心在知识和各样见识上多而又多，
verses.textEnNiv: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
verses.textEnEsv: And it is my prayer that your love may abound more and more, with knowledge and all discernment,
verses.textEnNkjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound still more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
verses.textEnNlt: I pray that your love will overflow more and more, and that you will keep on growing in knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: And this I pray, that your love may overflow still more and more in real knowledge and all discernment,
verses.textEn: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,

verses.textZh: 使你们可以辨别是非，成为真诚无可指摘的人，直到基督的日子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 使你们可以辨别是非，成为真诚无可指摘的人，直到基督的日子，
verses.textZhCuv: 使你们能分别是非 ，作诚实无过的人，直到基督的日子；
verses.textEnNiv: so that you may be able to discern what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: so that you may approve what is excellent, and so be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense till the day of Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: For I want you to understand what really matters, so that you may live pure and blameless lives until the day of Christ’s return.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you may discover the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and blameless for the day of Christ;
verses.textEn: so that you may be able to discern what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,

verses.textZh: 靠着耶稣基督结满了公义的果子，使神得着荣耀和赞美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 靠着耶稣基督结满了公义的果子，使神得着荣耀和赞美。
verses.textZhCuv: 并靠着耶稣基督结满了仁义的果子，叫荣耀称赞归与神。
verses.textEnNiv: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ—to the glory and praise of God.
verses.textEnEsv: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are by Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
verses.textEnNlt: May you always be filled with the fruit of your salvation—the righteous character produced in your life by Jesus Christ —for this will bring much glory and praise to God.
verses.textEnNasb: having been filled with the fruit of righteousness which comes through Jesus Christ, for the glory and praise of God.
verses.textEn: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ—to the glory and praise of God.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我愿意你们知道，我所遭遇的反而使福音更加兴旺了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我愿意你们知道，我所遭遇的反而使福音更加兴旺了，
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我愿意你们知道，我所遭遇的事更是叫福音兴旺，
verses.textEnNiv: Now I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that what has happened to me has actually served to advance the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: I want you to know, brothers, that what has happened to me has really served to advance the gospel,
verses.textEnNkjv: But I want you to know, brethren, that the things whichhappened to me have actually turned out for the furtherance of the gospel,
verses.textEnNlt: And I want you to know, my dear brothers and sisters, that everything that has happened to me here has helped to spread the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that my circumstances have turned out for the greater progress of the gospel,
verses.textEn: Now I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that what has happened to me has actually served to advance the gospel.

verses.textZh: 以致整个宫里的卫队和其余一切的人，都知道我是为了基督才受捆锁的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致整个宫里的卫队和其余一切的人，都知道我是为了基督才受捆锁的；
verses.textZhCuv: 以致我受的捆锁在御营全军和其余的人中，已经显明是为基督的缘故。
verses.textEnNiv: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: so that it has become known throughout the whole imperial guard and to all the rest that my imprisonment is for Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that it has become evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my chains are in Christ;
verses.textEnNlt: For everyone here, including the whole palace guard, knows that I am in chains because of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: so that my imprisonment in the cause of Christ has become well known throughout the praetorian guard and to everyone else,
verses.textEn: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.

verses.textZh: 而且大多数主内的弟兄，因我所受的捆锁，就笃信不疑，毫无畏惧，更勇敢地传讲神的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且大多数主内的弟兄，因我所受的捆锁，就笃信不疑，毫无畏惧，更勇敢地传讲神的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且那在主里的弟兄多半因我受的捆锁就笃信不疑，越发放胆传神的道，无所惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: And because of my chains, most of the brothers and sisters have become confident in the Lord and dare all the more to proclaim the gospel without fear.
verses.textEnEsv: And most of the brothers, having become confident in the Lord by my imprisonment, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.textEnNkjv: and most of the brethren in the Lord, having become confident by my chains, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.textEnNlt: And because of my imprisonment, most of the believers here have gained confidence and boldly speak God’s message without fear.
verses.textEnNasb: and that most of the brothers and sisters, trusting in the Lord because of my imprisonment, have far more courage to speak the word of God without fear.
verses.textEn: And because of my chains, most of the brothers and sisters have become confident in the Lord and dare all the more to proclaim the gospel without fear.

verses.textZh: 有些人传扬基督是出于嫉妒和纷争，但也有些人是出于好意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人传扬基督是出于嫉妒和纷争，但也有些人是出于好意。
verses.textZhCuv: 有的传基督是出于嫉妒纷争，也有的是出于好意。
verses.textEnNiv: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
verses.textEnEsv: Some indeed preach Christ from envy and rivalry, but others from good will.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some indeed preach Christ even from envy and strife, and some also from goodwill:
verses.textEnNlt: It’s true that some are preaching out of jealousy and rivalry. But others preach about Christ with pure motives.
verses.textEnNasb: Some, to be sure, are preaching Christ even from envy and strife, but some also from goodwill;
verses.textEn: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.

verses.textZh: 这些人是出于爱心，知道我是派来为福音辩护的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人是出于爱心，知道我是派来为福音辩护的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一等是出于爱心，知道我是为辩明福音设立的；
verses.textEnNiv: The latter do so out of love, knowing that I am put here for the defense of the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: The latter do it out of love, knowing that I am put here for the defense of the gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The former preach Christ from selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my chains;
verses.textEnNlt: They preach because they love me, for they know I have been appointed to defend the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: the latter do it out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel;
verses.textEn: The latter do so out of love, knowing that I am put here for the defense of the gospel.

verses.textZh: 那些人传讲基督却是出于自私，动机并不纯正，只想加重我在捆锁中的烦恼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人传讲基督却是出于自私，动机并不纯正，只想加重我在捆锁中的烦恼。
verses.textZhCuv: 那一等传基督是出于结党，并不诚实，意思要加增我捆锁的苦楚。
verses.textEnNiv: The former preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can stir up trouble for me while I am in chains.
verses.textEnEsv: The former proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely but thinking to afflict me in my imprisonment.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
verses.textEnNlt: Those others do not have pure motives as they preach about Christ. They preach with selfish ambition, not sincerely, intending to make my chains more painful to me.
verses.textEnNasb: the former proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition rather than from pure motives, thinking that they are causing me distress in my imprisonment.
verses.textEn: The former preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can stir up trouble for me while I am in chains.

verses.textZh: 那有甚么关系呢？真心也好，假意也好，无论怎么样，基督总被传开了，为此我就欢喜；并且我还要欢喜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那有甚么关系呢？真心也好，假意也好，无论怎么样，基督总被传开了，为此我就欢喜；并且我还要欢喜，
verses.textZhCuv: 这有何妨呢？或是假意，或是真心，无论怎样，基督究竟被传开了。为此，我就欢喜，并且还要欢喜；
verses.textEnNiv: But what does it matter? The important thing is that in every way, whether from false motives or true, Christ is preached. And because of this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
verses.textEnEsv: What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed, and in that I rejoice. Yes, and I will rejoice,
verses.textEnNkjv: What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is preached; and in this I rejoice, yes, and will rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: But that doesn’t matter. Whether their motives are false or genuine, the message about Christ is being preached either way, so I rejoice. And I will continue to rejoice.
verses.textEnNasb: What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed, and in this I rejoice. But not only that, I also will rejoice,
verses.textEn: But what does it matter? The important thing is that in every way, whether from false motives or true, Christ is preached. And because of this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,

verses.textZh: 因为我知道，借着你们的祈求和耶稣基督的灵的帮助，我一定会得到释放。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我知道，借着你们的祈求和耶稣基督的灵的帮助，我一定会得到释放。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我知道，这事藉着你们的祈祷和耶稣基督之灵的帮助，终必叫我得救。
verses.textEnNiv: for I know that through your prayers and God’s provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ what has happened to me will turn out for my deliverance.
verses.textEnEsv: for I know that through your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ this will turn out for my deliverance,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayer and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: For I know that as you pray for me and the Spirit of Jesus Christ helps me, this will lead to my deliverance.
verses.textEnNasb: for I know that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.textEn: for I know that through your prayers and God’s provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ what has happened to me will turn out for my deliverance.

verses.textZh: 我所热切期待和盼望的，就是在凡事上我都不会羞愧，只要满有胆量，不论生死，总要让基督在我身上照常被尊为大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所热切期待和盼望的，就是在凡事上我都不会羞愧，只要满有胆量，不论生死，总要让基督在我身上照常被尊为大。
verses.textZhCuv: 照着我所切慕、所盼望的，没有一事叫我羞愧。只要凡事放胆，无论是生是死，总叫基督在我身上照常显大。
verses.textEnNiv: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have sufficient courage so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
verses.textEnEsv: as it is my eager expectation and hope that I will not be at all ashamed, but that with full courage now as always Christ will be honored in my body, whether by life or by death.
verses.textEnNkjv: according to my earnest expectation and hope that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
verses.textEnNlt: For I fully expect and hope that I will never be ashamed, but that I will continue to be bold for Christ, as I have been in the past. And I trust that my life will bring honor to Christ, whether I live or die.
verses.textEnNasb: according to my eager expectation and hope, that I will not be put to shame in anything, but that with all boldness, Christ will even now, as always, be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
verses.textEn: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have sufficient courage so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.

verses.textZh: 因为我活着就是基督，我死了就有益处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我活着就是基督，我死了就有益处。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我活着就是基督，我死了就有益处。
verses.textEnNiv: For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain.
verses.textEnEsv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.textEnNkjv: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.textEnNlt: For to me, living means living for Christ, and dying is even better.
verses.textEnNasb: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.textEn: For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain.

verses.textZh: 但如果我仍在世上活着，能够使我的工作有成果，我就不知道应该怎样选择了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果我仍在世上活着，能够使我的工作有成果，我就不知道应该怎样选择了！
verses.textZhCuv: 但我在肉身活着，若成就我工夫的果子，我就不知道该挑选什么。
verses.textEnNiv: If I am to go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. Yet what shall I choose? I do not know!
verses.textEnEsv: If I am to live in the flesh, that means fruitful labor for me. Yet which I shall choose I cannot tell.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if I live on in the flesh, this willmean fruit from my labor; yet what I shall choose I cannot tell.
verses.textEnNlt: But if I live, I can do more fruitful work for Christ. So I really don’t know which is better.
verses.textEnNasb: But if I am to live on in the flesh, this will mean fruitful labor for me; and I do not know which to choose.
verses.textEn: If I am to go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. Yet what shall I choose? I do not know!

verses.textZh: 我处于两难之间，情愿离世与基督同在，因为那是好得无比的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我处于两难之间，情愿离世与基督同在，因为那是好得无比的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我正在两难之间，情愿离世与基督同在，因为这是好得无比的。
verses.textEnNiv: I am torn between the two: I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is better by far;
verses.textEnEsv: I am hard pressed between the two. My desire is to depart and be with Christ, for that is far better.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am hard-pressed between the two, having a desire to depart and be with Christ, whichis far better.
verses.textEnNlt: I’m torn between two desires: I long to go and be with Christ, which would be far better for me.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am hard-pressed from both directions, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, for that is very much better;
verses.textEn: I am torn between the two: I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is better by far;

verses.textZh: 可是为了你们，我更需要活在世上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是为了你们，我更需要活在世上。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我在肉身活着，为你们更是要紧的。
verses.textEnNiv: but it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
verses.textEnEsv: But to remain in the flesh is more necessary on your account.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless to remain in the flesh is more needful for you.
verses.textEnNlt: But for your sakes, it is better that I continue to live.
verses.textEnNasb: yet to remain on in the flesh is more necessary for your sakes.
verses.textEn: but it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.

verses.textZh: 我既然这样深信，就知道还要活下去，并且要继续和你们大家在一起，使你们在信心上有长进，有喜乐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我既然这样深信，就知道还要活下去，并且要继续和你们大家在一起，使你们在信心上有长进，有喜乐，
verses.textZhCuv: 我既然这样深信，就知道仍要住在世间，且与你们众人同住，使你们在所信的道上又长进又喜乐，
verses.textEnNiv: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain, and I will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
verses.textEnEsv: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and continue with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith,
verses.textEnNkjv: And being confident of this, I know that I shall remain and continue with you all for your progress and joy of faith,
verses.textEnNlt: Knowing this, I am convinced that I will remain alive so I can continue to help all of you grow and experience the joy of your faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and continue with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
verses.textEn: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain, and I will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,

verses.textZh: 以致你们因为我要再到你们那里去，就在基督耶稣里更加以我为荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致你们因为我要再到你们那里去，就在基督耶稣里更加以我为荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫你们在基督耶稣里的欢乐，因我再到你们那里去，就越发加增。
verses.textEnNiv: so that through my being with you again your boasting in Christ Jesus will abound on account of me.
verses.textEnEsv: so that in me you may have ample cause to glory in Christ Jesus, because of my coming to you again.
verses.textEnNkjv: that your rejoicing for me may be more abundant in Jesus Christ by my coming to you again.
verses.textEnNlt: And when I come to you again, you will have even more reason to take pride in Christ Jesus because of what he is doing through me.
verses.textEnNasb: so that your pride in Christ Jesus may be abundant because of me by my coming to you again.
verses.textEn: so that through my being with you again your boasting in Christ Jesus will abound on account of me.

verses.textZh: 不过，你们行事为人 应当和基督的福音相配。这样，无论我来见你们或是不在你们中间，都可以听到你们的情况，就是你们有同一的心志，站立得稳，为了福音的信仰齐心努力，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，你们行事为人 应当和基督的福音相配。这样，无论我来见你们或是不在你们中间，都可以听到你们的情况，就是你们有同一的心志，站立得稳，为了福音的信仰齐心努力，
verses.textZhCuv: 只要你们行事为人与基督的福音相称，叫我或来见你们，或不在你们那里，可以听见你们的景况，知道你们同有一个心志，站立得稳，为所信的福音齐心努力。
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever happens, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in the one Spirit, striving together as one for the faith of the gospel
verses.textEnEsv: Only let your manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of you that you are standing firm in one spirit, with one mind striving side by side for the faith of the gospel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Only let your conduct be worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your affairs, that you stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel,
verses.textEnNlt: Above all, you must live as citizens of heaven, conducting yourselves in a manner worthy of the Good News about Christ. Then, whether I come and see you again or only hear about you, I will know that you are standing together with one spirit and one purpose, fighting together for the faith, which is the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: Only conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or remain absent, I will hear about you that you are standing firm in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.textEn: Whatever happens, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in the one Spirit, striving together as one for the faith of the gospel

verses.textZh: 甚么事都不怕有反对你们的人，这就证明他们要灭亡，你们要得救，这都是出于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚么事都不怕有反对你们的人，这就证明他们要灭亡，你们要得救，这都是出于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事不怕敌人的惊吓，这是证明他们沉沦，你们得救都是出于神。
verses.textEnNiv: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a sign to them that they will be destroyed, but that you will be saved—and that by God.
verses.textEnEsv: and not frightened in anything by your opponents. This is a clear sign to them of their destruction, but of your salvation, and that from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and not in any way terrified by your adversaries, which is to them a proof of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be intimidated in any way by your enemies. This will be a sign to them that they are going to be destroyed, but that you are going to be saved, even by God himself.
verses.textEnNasb: and in no way alarmed by your opponents—which is a sign of destruction for them, but of salvation for you, and this too, from God.
verses.textEn: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a sign to them that they will be destroyed, but that you will be saved—and that by God.

verses.textZh: 因为神为了基督的缘故赐恩给你们，使你们不单是信基督，也是要为他受苦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神为了基督的缘故赐恩给你们，使你们不单是信基督，也是要为他受苦；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们蒙恩，不但得以信服基督，并要为他受苦。
verses.textEnNiv: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in him, but also to suffer for him,
verses.textEnEsv: For it has been granted to you that for the sake of Christ you should not only believe in him but also suffer for his sake,
verses.textEnNkjv: For to you it has been granted on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for His sake,
verses.textEnNlt: For you have been given not only the privilege of trusting in Christ but also the privilege of suffering for him.
verses.textEnNasb: For to you it has been granted for Christ’s sake, not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer on His behalf,
verses.textEn: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in him, but also to suffer for him,

verses.textZh: 你们面对的争战，和你们在我身上所见过，现在又听到的是一样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们面对的争战，和你们在我身上所见过，现在又听到的是一样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的争战，就与你们在我身上从前所看见、现在所听见的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: since you are going through the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
verses.textEnEsv: engaged in the same conflict that you saw I had and now hear that I still have.
verses.textEnNkjv: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
verses.textEnNlt: We are in this struggle together. You have seen my struggle in the past, and you know that I am still in the midst of it.
verses.textEnNasb: experiencing the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
verses.textEn: since you are going through the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们在基督里若有甚么鼓励，有甚么爱心的安慰，有甚么灵里的契通，有甚么慈悲和怜悯，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们在基督里若有甚么鼓励，有甚么爱心的安慰，有甚么灵里的契通，有甚么慈悲和怜悯，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，在基督里若有什么劝勉，爱心有什么安慰，圣灵有什么交通，心中有什么慈悲怜悯，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore if you have any encouragement from being united with Christ, if any comfort from his love, if any common sharing in the Spirit, if any tenderness and compassion,
verses.textEnEsv: So if there is any encouragement in Christ, any comfort from love, any participation in the Spirit, any affection and sympathy,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore if thereis any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any affection and mercy,
verses.textEnNlt: Is there any encouragement from belonging to Christ? Any comfort from his love? Any fellowship together in the Spirit? Are your hearts tender and compassionate?
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore if there is any encouragement in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
verses.textEn: Therefore if you have any encouragement from being united with Christ, if any comfort from his love, if any common sharing in the Spirit, if any tenderness and compassion,

verses.textZh: 就应当有同样的思想，同样的爱心，要心志相同，思想一致，使我充满喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就应当有同样的思想，同样的爱心，要心志相同，思想一致，使我充满喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就要意念相同，爱心相同，有一样的心思，有一样的意念，使我的喜乐可以满足。
verses.textEnNiv: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being one in spirit and of one mind.
verses.textEnEsv: complete my joy by being of the same mind, having the same love, being in full accord and of one mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: fulfill my joy by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
verses.textEnNlt: Then make me truly happy by agreeing wholeheartedly with each other, loving one another, and working together with one mind and purpose.
verses.textEnNasb: make my joy complete by being of the same mind, maintaining the same love, united in spirit, intent on one purpose.
verses.textEn: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being one in spirit and of one mind.

verses.textZh: 不要自私自利，也不要贪图虚荣，只要谦卑，看别人比自己强；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要自私自利，也不要贪图虚荣，只要谦卑，看别人比自己强；
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。
verses.textEnNiv: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves,
verses.textEnEsv: Do nothing from selfish ambition or conceit, but in humility count others more significant than yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let nothing bedone through selfish ambition or conceit, but in lowliness of mind let each esteem others better than himself.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be selfish; don’t try to impress others. Be humble, thinking of others as better than yourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: Do nothing from selfishness or empty conceit, but with humility consider one another as more important than yourselves;
verses.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves,

verses.textZh: 各人不要单顾自己的事，也要顾别人的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人不要单顾自己的事，也要顾别人的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人不要单顾自己的事，也要顾别人的事。
verses.textEnNiv: not looking to your own interests but each of you to the interests of the others.
verses.textEnEsv: Let each of you look not only to his own interests, but also to the interests of others.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let each of you look out not only for his own interests, but also for the interests of others.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t look out only for your own interests, but take an interest in others, too.
verses.textEnNasb: do not merely look out for your own personal interests, but also for the interests of others.
verses.textEn: not looking to your own interests but each of you to the interests of the others.

verses.textZh: 你们应当有这样的思想，这也是基督耶稣的思想。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应当有这样的思想，这也是基督耶稣的思想。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当以基督耶稣的心为心：
verses.textEnNiv: In your relationships with one another, have the same mindset as Christ Jesus:
verses.textEnEsv: Have this mind among yourselves, which is yours in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: You must have the same attitude that Christ Jesus had.
verses.textEnNasb: Have this attitude in yourselves which was also in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEn: In your relationships with one another, have the same mindset as Christ Jesus:

verses.textZh: 他本来有神的形象，却不坚持自己与神平等的地位，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他本来有神的形象，却不坚持自己与神平等的地位，
verses.textZhCuv: 他本有神的形象， 不以自己与神同等为强夺的；
verses.textEnNiv: Who, being in very nature God, did not consider equality with God something to be used to his own advantage;
verses.textEnEsv: who, though he was in the form of God, did not count equality with God a thing to be grasped,
verses.textEnNkjv: who, being in the form of God, did not consider it robbery to be equal with God,
verses.textEnNlt: Though he was God, he did not think of equality with God as something to cling to.
verses.textEnNasb: who, as He already existed in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,
verses.textEn: Who, being in very nature God, did not consider equality with God something to be used to his own advantage;

verses.textZh: 反而倒空自己，取了奴仆的形象，成为人的样式；
verses.textZhCnvs: 反而倒空自己，取了奴仆的形象，成为人的样式；
verses.textZhCuv: 反倒虚己， 取了奴仆的形象， 成为人的样式；
verses.textEnNiv: rather, he made himself nothing by taking the very nature of a servant, being made in human likeness.
verses.textEnEsv: but emptied himself, by taking the form of a servant, being born in the likeness of men.
verses.textEnNkjv: but made Himself of no reputation, taking the form of a bondservant, and coming in the likeness of men.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, he gave up his divine privileges ; he took the humble position of a slave and was born as a human being. When he appeared in human form,
verses.textEnNasb: but emptied Himself by taking the form of a bond-servant and being born in the likeness of men.
verses.textEn: rather, he made himself nothing by taking the very nature of a servant, being made in human likeness.

verses.textZh: 既然有人的样子，就自甘卑微，顺服至死，而且死在十字架上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然有人的样子，就自甘卑微，顺服至死，而且死在十字架上。
verses.textZhCuv: 既有人的样子，就自己卑微， 存心顺服，以至于死， 且死在十字架上。
verses.textEnNiv: And being found in appearance as a man, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to death— even death on a cross!
verses.textEnEsv: And being found in human form, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross.
verses.textEnNkjv: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to thepointof death, even the death of the cross.
verses.textEnNlt: he humbled himself in obedience to God and died a criminal’s death on a cross.
verses.textEnNasb: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself by becoming obedient to the point of death: death on a cross.
verses.textEn: And being found in appearance as a man, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to death— even death on a cross!

verses.textZh: 因此神把他升为至高，并且赐给他超过万名之上的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此神把他升为至高，并且赐给他超过万名之上的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，神将他升为至高， 又赐给他那超乎万名之上的名，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore God exalted him to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore God has highly exalted him and bestowed on him the name that is above every name,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore God also has highly exalted Him and given Him the name which is above every name,
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, God elevated him to the place of highest honor and gave him the name above all other names,
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason also God highly exalted Him, and bestowed on Him the name which is above every name,
verses.textEn: Therefore God exalted him to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name,

verses.textZh: 使天上、地上和地底下的一切，因着耶稣的名，都要屈膝，
verses.textZhCnvs: 使天上、地上和地底下的一切，因着耶稣的名，都要屈膝，
verses.textZhCuv: 叫一切在天上的、地上的，和地底下的， 因耶稣的名无不屈膝，
verses.textEnNiv: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
verses.textEnEsv: so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, and of those on earth, and of those under the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
verses.textEnNasb: so that at the name of Jesus every knee will bow, of those who are in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
verses.textEn: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

verses.textZh: 并且口里承认耶稣基督为主，使荣耀归给父神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且口里承认耶稣基督为主，使荣耀归给父神。
verses.textZhCuv: 无不口称「耶稣基督为主」， 使荣耀归与父神。
verses.textEnNiv: and every tongue acknowledge that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.textEnEsv: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: and every tongue declare that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.textEnNasb: and that every tongue will confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.textEn: and every tongue acknowledge that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

verses.textZh: 这样看来，我所亲爱的，你们素来是顺服的， 就应当恐惧战兢地作成自己的救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，我所亲爱的，你们素来是顺服的， 就应当恐惧战兢地作成自己的救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，我亲爱的弟兄，你们既是常顺服的，不但我在你们那里，就是我如今不在你们那里，更是顺服的，就当恐惧战兢做成你们得救的工夫。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, my dear friends, as you have always obeyed—not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence—continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, so now, not only as in my presence but much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, you always followed my instructions when I was with you. And now that I am away, it is even more important. Work hard to show the results of your salvation, obeying God with deep reverence and fear.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;
verses.textEn: Therefore, my dear friends, as you have always obeyed—not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence—continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling,

verses.textZh: 神为了成全自己的美意，就在你们里面动工，使你们可以立志和行事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神为了成全自己的美意，就在你们里面动工，使你们可以立志和行事。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们立志行事都是神在你们心里运行，为要成就他的美意。
verses.textEnNiv: for it is God who works in you to will and to act in order to fulfill his good purpose.
verses.textEnEsv: for it is God who works in you, both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
verses.textEnNkjv: for it is God who works in you both to will and to do for His good pleasure.
verses.textEnNlt: For God is working in you, giving you the desire and the power to do what pleases him.
verses.textEnNasb: for it is God who is at work in you, both to desire and to work for His good pleasure.
verses.textEn: for it is God who works in you to will and to act in order to fulfill his good purpose.

verses.textZh: 无论作甚么，都不要发怨言、起争论，
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论作甚么，都不要发怨言、起争论，
verses.textZhCuv: 凡所行的，都不要发怨言，起争论，
verses.textEnNiv: Do everything without grumbling or arguing,
verses.textEnEsv: Do all things without grumbling or disputing,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do all things without complaining and disputing,
verses.textEnNlt: Do everything without complaining and arguing,
verses.textEnNasb: Do all things without complaining or arguments;
verses.textEn: Do everything without grumbling or arguing,

verses.textZh: 好使你们无可指摘、纯真无邪，在这弯曲乖谬的世代中，作神没有瑕疵的儿女；你们要在这世代中发光，好象天上的光体一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使你们无可指摘、纯真无邪，在这弯曲乖谬的世代中，作神没有瑕疵的儿女；你们要在这世代中发光，好象天上的光体一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 使你们无可指摘，诚实无伪，在这弯曲悖谬的世代作神无瑕疵的儿女。你们显在这世代中，好像明光照耀，
verses.textEnNiv: so that you may become blameless and pure, "children of God without fault in a warped and crooked generation." Then you will shine among them like stars in the sky
verses.textEnEsv: that you may be blameless and innocent, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and twisted generation, among whom you shine as lights in the world,
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without fault in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you shine as lights in the world,
verses.textEnNlt: so that no one can criticize you. Live clean, innocent lives as children of God, shining like bright lights in a world full of crooked and perverse people.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you will prove yourselves to be blameless and innocent, children of God above reproach in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you appear as lights in the world,
verses.textEn: so that you may become blameless and pure, "children of God without fault in a warped and crooked generation." Then you will shine among them like stars in the sky

verses.textZh: 把生命的道显扬出来，使我在基督的日子可以夸耀我没有空跑，也没有徒劳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把生命的道显扬出来，使我在基督的日子可以夸耀我没有空跑，也没有徒劳。
verses.textZhCuv: 将生命的道表明出来，叫我在基督的日子好夸我没有空跑，也没有徒劳。
verses.textEnNiv: as you hold firmly to the word of life. And then I will be able to boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
verses.textEnEsv: holding fast to the word of life, so that in the day of Christ I may be proud that I did not run in vain or labor in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: holding fast the word of life, so that I may rejoice in the day of Christ that I have not run in vain or labored in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: Hold firmly to the word of life; then, on the day of Christ’s return, I will be proud that I did not run the race in vain and that my work was not useless.
verses.textEnNasb: holding firmly the word of life, so that on the day of Christ I can take pride because I did not run in vain nor labor in vain.
verses.textEn: as you hold firmly to the word of life. And then I will be able to boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.

verses.textZh: 即使把我浇奠在你们信心的祭物和供奉上，我也喜乐，并且和你们大家一同喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使把我浇奠在你们信心的祭物和供奉上，我也喜乐，并且和你们大家一同喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我以你们的信心为供献的祭物，我若被浇奠在其上，也是喜乐，并且与你们众人一同喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service coming from your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
verses.textEnEsv: Even if I am to be poured out as a drink offering upon the sacrificial offering of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, and if I am being poured out asadrinkoffering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will rejoice even if I lose my life, pouring it out like a liquid offering to God, just like your faithful service is an offering to God. And I want all of you to share that joy.
verses.textEnNasb: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and share my joy with you all.
verses.textEn: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service coming from your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.

verses.textZh: 照样，你们也要喜乐，并且要和我一同喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，你们也要喜乐，并且要和我一同喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也要照样喜乐，并且与我一同喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the same reason you also be glad and rejoice with me.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you should rejoice, and I will share your joy.
verses.textEnNasb: You too, I urge you, rejoice in the same way and share your joy with me.
verses.textEn: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.

verses.textZh: 我靠着主耶稣，希望不久就会差提摩太到你们那里去，使我们知道你们的情况，可以得到鼓励。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我靠着主耶稣，希望不久就会差提摩太到你们那里去，使我们知道你们的情况，可以得到鼓励。
verses.textZhCuv: 我靠主耶稣指望快打发提摩太去见你们，叫我知道你们的事，心里就得着安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I receive news about you.
verses.textEnEsv: I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, so that I too may be cheered by news of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you shortly, that I also may be encouraged when I know your state.
verses.textEnNlt: If the Lord Jesus is willing, I hope to send Timothy to you soon for a visit. Then he can cheer me up by telling me how you are getting along.
verses.textEnNasb: But I hope, in the Lord Jesus, to send Timothy to you shortly, so that I also may be encouraged when I learn of your condition.
verses.textEn: I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I receive news about you.

verses.textZh: 没有人与我同心，真正关心你们的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人与我同心，真正关心你们的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我没有别人与我同心，实在挂念你们的事。
verses.textEnNiv: I have no one else like him, who will show genuine concern for your welfare.
verses.textEnEsv: For I have no one like him, who will be genuinely concerned for your welfare.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have no one like-minded, who will sincerely care for your state.
verses.textEnNlt: I have no one else like Timothy, who genuinely cares about your welfare.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have no one else of kindred spirit who will genuinely be concerned for your welfare.
verses.textEn: I have no one else like him, who will show genuine concern for your welfare.

verses.textZh: 因为大家只顾自己的事，而不理耶稣基督的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为大家只顾自己的事，而不理耶稣基督的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 别人都求自己的事，并不求耶稣基督的事。
verses.textEnNiv: For everyone looks out for their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For they all seek their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: All the others care only for themselves and not for what matters to Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For they all seek after their own interests, not those of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: For everyone looks out for their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 不过，你们知道提摩太已证明了他的为人，他和我一同为了福音服事主，就像儿子跟父亲一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，你们知道提摩太已证明了他的为人，他和我一同为了福音服事主，就像儿子跟父亲一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们知道提摩太的明证；他兴旺福音，与我同劳，待我像儿子待父亲一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But you know that Timothy has proved himself, because as a son with his father he has served with me in the work of the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, how as a son with a father he has served with me in the gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you know his proven character, that as a son with his father he served with me in the gospel.
verses.textEnNlt: But you know how Timothy has proved himself. Like a son with his father, he has served with me in preaching the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: But you know of his proven character, that he served with me in the furtherance of the gospel like a child serving his father.
verses.textEn: But you know that Timothy has proved himself, because as a son with his father he has served with me in the work of the gospel.

verses.textZh: 所以，等我看出自己的事会怎样了结之后，我希望立刻差他去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，等我看出自己的事会怎样了结之后，我希望立刻差他去；
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我一看出我的事要怎样了结，就盼望立刻打发他去；
verses.textEnNiv: I hope, therefore, to send him as soon as I see how things go with me.
verses.textEnEsv: I hope therefore to send him just as soon as I see how it will go with me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it goes with me.
verses.textEnNlt: I hope to send him to you just as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me here.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I hope to send him immediately, as soon as I see how things go with me;
verses.textEn: I hope, therefore, to send him as soon as I see how things go with me.

verses.textZh: 而且靠着主，我相信自己不久也会去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且靠着主，我相信自己不久也会去。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我靠着主自信我也必快去。
verses.textEnNiv: And I am confident in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
verses.textEnEsv: and I trust in the Lord that shortly I myself will come also.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I trust in the Lord that I myself shall also come shortly.
verses.textEnNlt: And I have confidence from the Lord that I myself will come to see you soon.
verses.textEnNasb: and I trust in the Lord that I myself will also be coming shortly.
verses.textEn: And I am confident in the Lord that I myself will come soon.

verses.textZh: 然而我认为必须差以巴弗提到你们那里去，他是我的弟兄，与我一同作工一同作战的，也是你们为我的需要差来服事我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我认为必须差以巴弗提到你们那里去，他是我的弟兄，与我一同作工一同作战的，也是你们为我的需要差来服事我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我想必须打发以巴弗提到你们那里去。他是我的兄弟，与我一同做工，一同当兵，是你们所差遣的，也是供给我需用的。
verses.textEnNiv: But I think it is necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, co-worker and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger, whom you sent to take care of my needs.
verses.textEnEsv: I have thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus my brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier, and your messenger and minister to my need,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I considered it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, but your messenger and the one who ministered to my need;
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, I thought I should send Epaphroditus back to you. He is a true brother, co-worker, and fellow soldier. And he was your messenger to help me in my need.
verses.textEnNasb: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my need,
verses.textEn: But I think it is necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, co-worker and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger, whom you sent to take care of my needs.

verses.textZh: 他一直在想念你们众人，并且因为你们听见他病了，他就非常难过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一直在想念你们众人，并且因为你们听见他病了，他就非常难过。
verses.textZhCuv: 他很想念你们众人，并且极其难过，因为你们听见他病了。
verses.textEnNiv: For he longs for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
verses.textEnEsv: for he has been longing for you all and has been distressed because you heard that he was ill.
verses.textEnNkjv: since he was longing for you all, and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick.
verses.textEnNlt: I am sending him because he has been longing to see you, and he was very distressed that you heard he was ill.
verses.textEnNasb: because he was longing for you all and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick.
verses.textEn: For he longs for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.

verses.textZh: 事实上他病得几乎要死，然而神怜悯了他；不但怜悯他，也怜悯我，免得我忧上加忧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 事实上他病得几乎要死，然而神怜悯了他；不但怜悯他，也怜悯我，免得我忧上加忧。
verses.textZhCuv: 他实在是病了，几乎要死；然而神怜恤他，不但怜恤他，也怜恤我，免得我忧上加忧。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed he was ill, and almost died. But God had mercy on him, and not on him only but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed he was ill, near to death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed he was sick almost unto death; but God had mercy on him, and not only on him but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.textEnNlt: And he certainly was ill; in fact, he almost died. But God had mercy on him—and also on me, so that I would not have one sorrow after another.
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed he was sick to the point of death, but God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.textEn: Indeed he was ill, and almost died. But God had mercy on him, and not on him only but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.

verses.textZh: 所以，我更急着差他去，让你们再见到他，就可以喜乐，也可以减少我的挂虑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我更急着差他去，让你们再见到他，就可以喜乐，也可以减少我的挂虑。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我越发急速打发他去，叫你们再见他，就可以喜乐，我也可以少些忧愁。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may be glad and I may have less anxiety.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the more eager to send him, therefore, that you may rejoice at seeing him again, and that I may be less anxious.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I sent him the more eagerly, that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less sorrowful.
verses.textEnNlt: So I am all the more anxious to send him back to you, for I know you will be glad to see him, and then I will not be so worried about you.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I have sent him all the more eagerly, so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less concerned about you.
verses.textEn: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may be glad and I may have less anxiety.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们要在主里欢欢喜喜地接待他，也要尊重这样的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们要在主里欢欢喜喜地接待他，也要尊重这样的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，你们要在主里欢欢乐乐地接待他，而且要尊重这样的人；
verses.textEnNiv: So then, welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor people like him,
verses.textEnEsv: So receive him in the Lord with all joy, and honor such men,
verses.textEnNkjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness, and hold such men in esteem;
verses.textEnNlt: Welcome him in the Lord’s love and with great joy, and give him the honor that people like him deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: Receive him then in the Lord with all joy, and hold people like him in high regard,
verses.textEn: So then, welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor people like him,

verses.textZh: 因他为了基督的工作，冒着生命的危险，差一点丧了命，为的是要补满你们服事我不足的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因他为了基督的工作，冒着生命的危险，差一点丧了命，为的是要补满你们服事我不足的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他为做基督的工夫，几乎至死，不顾性命，要补足你们供给我的不及之处。
verses.textEnNiv: because he almost died for the work of Christ. He risked his life to make up for the help you yourselves could not give me.
verses.textEnEsv: for he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was lacking in your service to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: because for the work of Christ he came close to death, not regarding his life, to supply what was lacking in your service toward me.
verses.textEnNlt: For he risked his life for the work of Christ, and he was at the point of death while doing for me what you couldn’t do from far away.
verses.textEnNasb: because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to compensate for your absence in your service to me.
verses.textEn: because he almost died for the work of Christ. He risked his life to make up for the help you yourselves could not give me.

verses.textZh: 最后，我的弟兄们，你们要靠着主喜乐。我写这些话给你们，在我并不困难，对你们却是妥当的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后，我的弟兄们，你们要靠着主喜乐。我写这些话给你们，在我并不困难，对你们却是妥当的。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我还有话说，你们要靠主喜乐。我把这话再写给你们，于我并不为难，于你们却是妥当。
verses.textEnNiv: Further, my brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord! It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.
verses.textEnEsv: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you is no trouble to me and is safe for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. For me to write the same things to you is not tedious, but for you itis safe.
verses.textEnNlt: Whatever happens, my dear brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord. I never get tired of telling you these things, and I do it to safeguard your faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Finally, my brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things again is no trouble for me, and it is a safeguard for you.
verses.textEn: Further, my brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord! It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.

verses.textZh: 你们要提防那些"狗"，提防作恶的，提防行割礼的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要提防那些"狗"，提防作恶的，提防行割礼的。
verses.textZhCuv: 应当防备犬类，防备作恶的，防备妄自行割的。
verses.textEnNiv: Watch out for those dogs, those evildoers, those mutilators of the flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: Look out for the dogs, look out for the evildoers, look out for those who mutilate the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the mutilation!
verses.textEnNlt: Watch out for those dogs, those people who do evil, those mutilators who say you must be circumcised to be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the false circumcision;
verses.textEn: Watch out for those dogs, those evildoers, those mutilators of the flesh.

verses.textZh: 其实我们这些靠神的灵来敬拜，在基督耶稣里夸口而不倚靠肉体的人，才是受割礼的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实我们这些靠神的灵来敬拜，在基督耶稣里夸口而不倚靠肉体的人，才是受割礼的，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为真受割礼的，乃是我们这以神的灵敬拜、在基督耶稣里夸口、不靠着肉体的。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who serve God by his Spirit, who boast in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
verses.textEnEsv: For we are the circumcision, who worship by the Spirit of God and glory in Christ Jesus and put no confidence in the flesh—
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh,
verses.textEnNlt: For we who worship by the Spirit of God are the ones who are truly circumcised. We rely on what Christ Jesus has done for us. We put no confidence in human effort,
verses.textEnNasb: for we are the true circumcision, who worship in the Spirit of God and take pride in Christ Jesus, and put no confidence in the flesh,
verses.textEn: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who serve God by his Spirit, who boast in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—

verses.textZh: 虽然我有理由可以倚靠肉体。如果别人认为可以倚靠肉体，我就更加可以了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我有理由可以倚靠肉体。如果别人认为可以倚靠肉体，我就更加可以了；
verses.textZhCuv: 其实，我也可以靠肉体；若是别人想他可以靠肉体，我更可以靠着了。
verses.textEnNiv: though I myself have reasons for such confidence. If someone else thinks they have reasons to put confidence in the flesh, I have more:
verses.textEnEsv: though I myself have reason for confidence in the flesh also. If anyone else thinks he has reason for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
verses.textEnNkjv: though I also might have confidence in the flesh. If anyone else thinks he may have confidence in the flesh, I more so:
verses.textEnNlt: though I could have confidence in my own effort if anyone could. Indeed, if others have reason for confidence in their own efforts, I have even more!
verses.textEnNasb: although I myself could boast as having confidence even in the flesh. If anyone else thinks he is confident in the flesh, I have more reason:
verses.textEn: though I myself have reasons for such confidence. If someone else thinks they have reasons to put confidence in the flesh, I have more:

verses.textZh: 我第八天受割礼，属于以色列民族便雅悯支派，是希伯来人所生的希伯来人。按着律法来说，我是个法利赛人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我第八天受割礼，属于以色列民族便雅悯支派，是希伯来人所生的希伯来人。按着律法来说，我是个法利赛人；
verses.textZhCuv: 我第八天受割礼；我是以色列族、便雅悯支派的人，是希伯来人所生的希伯来人。就律法说，我是法利赛人；
verses.textEnNiv: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; in regard to the law, a Pharisee;
verses.textEnEsv: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
verses.textEnNkjv: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of the Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
verses.textEnNlt: I was circumcised when I was eight days old. I am a pure-blooded citizen of Israel and a member of the tribe of Benjamin—a real Hebrew if there ever was one! I was a member of the Pharisees, who demand the strictest obedience to the Jewish law.
verses.textEnNasb: circumcised the eighth day, of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the Law, a Pharisee;
verses.textEn: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; in regard to the law, a Pharisee;

verses.textZh: 按着热诚来说，我是迫害教会的；按着律法上的义来说，我是无可指摘的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着热诚来说，我是迫害教会的；按着律法上的义来说，我是无可指摘的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就热心说，我是逼迫教会的；就律法上的义说，我是无可指摘的。
verses.textEnNiv: as for zeal, persecuting the church; as for righteousness based on the law, faultless.
verses.textEnEsv: as to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to righteousness under the law, blameless.
verses.textEnNkjv: concerning zeal, persecuting the church; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
verses.textEnNlt: I was so zealous that I harshly persecuted the church. And as for righteousness, I obeyed the law without fault.
verses.textEnNasb: as to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to the righteousness which is in the Law, found blameless.
verses.textEn: as for zeal, persecuting the church; as for righteousness based on the law, faultless.

verses.textZh: 然而以前对我有益的，现在因着基督的缘故，我都当作是有损的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而以前对我有益的，现在因着基督的缘故，我都当作是有损的。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是我先前以为与我有益的，我现在因基督都当作有损的。
verses.textEnNiv: But whatever were gains to me I now consider loss for the sake of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: But whatever gain I had, I counted as loss for the sake of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: But what things were gain to me, these I have counted loss for Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: I once thought these things were valuable, but now I consider them worthless because of what Christ has done.
verses.textEnNasb: But whatever things were gain to me, these things I have counted as loss because of Christ.
verses.textEn: But whatever were gains to me I now consider loss for the sake of Christ.

verses.textZh: 不但这样，我也把万事当作是有损的，因为我以认识我主基督耶稣为至宝。为了他，我把万事都拋弃了，看作废物，为了要得着基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但这样，我也把万事当作是有损的，因为我以认识我主基督耶稣为至宝。为了他，我把万事都拋弃了，看作废物，为了要得着基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 不但如此，我也将万事当作有损的，因我以认识我主基督耶稣为至宝。我为他已经丢弃万事，看作粪土，为要得着基督；
verses.textEnNiv: What is more, I consider everything a loss because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have lost all things. I consider them garbage, that I may gain Christ
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, I count everything as loss because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake I have suffered the loss of all things and count them as rubbish, in order that I may gain Christ
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet indeed I also count all things loss for the excellence of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them as rubbish, that I may gain Christ
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, everything else is worthless when compared with the infinite value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake I have discarded everything else, counting it all as garbage, so that I could gain Christ
verses.textEnNasb: More than that, I count all things to be loss in view of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them mere rubbish, so that I may gain Christ,
verses.textEn: What is more, I consider everything a loss because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have lost all things. I consider them garbage, that I may gain Christ

verses.textZh: 并且得以在他里面，不是有自己因律法而得的义，而是有因信基督而得的义，就是基于信心，从神而来的义，
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且得以在他里面，不是有自己因律法而得的义，而是有因信基督而得的义，就是基于信心，从神而来的义，
verses.textZhCuv: 并且得以在他里面，不是有自己因律法而得的义，乃是有信基督的义，就是因信神而来的义，
verses.textEnNiv: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ—the righteousness that comes from God on the basis of faith.
verses.textEnEsv: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which comes through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God that depends on faith—
verses.textEnNkjv: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness, which is from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith;
verses.textEnNlt: and become one with him. I no longer count on my own righteousness through obeying the law; rather, I become righteous through faith in Christ. For God’s way of making us right with himself depends on faith.
verses.textEnNasb: and may be found in Him, not having a righteousness of my own derived from the Law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which comes from God on the basis of faith,
verses.textEn: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ—the righteousness that comes from God on the basis of faith.

verses.textZh: 使我认识基督和他复活的大能，并且在他所受的苦上有分，受他所受的死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我认识基督和他复活的大能，并且在他所受的苦上有分，受他所受的死；
verses.textZhCuv: 使我认识基督，晓得他复活的大能，并且晓得和他一同受苦，效法他的死，
verses.textEnNiv: I want to know Christ—yes, to know the power of his resurrection and participation in his sufferings, becoming like him in his death,
verses.textEnEsv: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and may share his sufferings, becoming like him in his death,
verses.textEnNkjv: that I may know Him and the power of His resurrection, and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to His death,
verses.textEnNlt: I want to know Christ and experience the mighty power that raised him from the dead. I want to suffer with him, sharing in his death,
verses.textEnNasb: that I may know Him and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to His death;
verses.textEn: I want to know Christ—yes, to know the power of his resurrection and participation in his sufferings, becoming like him in his death,

verses.textZh: 这样，我也许可以从死人中复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我也许可以从死人中复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 或者我也得以从死里复活。
verses.textEnNiv: and so, somehow, attaining to the resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: that by any means possible I may attain the resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: if, by any means, I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: so that one way or another I will experience the resurrection from the dead!
verses.textEnNasb: if somehow I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEn: and so, somehow, attaining to the resurrection from the dead.

verses.textZh: 这并不是说我已经得着了，已经完全了，而是竭力追求，好使我可以得着基督耶稣所以得着我的 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这并不是说我已经得着了，已经完全了，而是竭力追求，好使我可以得着基督耶稣所以得着我的 。
verses.textZhCuv: 这不是说我已经得着了，已经完全了；我乃是竭力追求，或者可以得着基督耶稣所以得着我的 。
verses.textEnNiv: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already arrived at my goal, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
verses.textEnEsv: Not that I have already obtained this or am already perfect, but I press on to make it my own, because Christ Jesus has made me his own.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not that I have already attained, or am already perfected; but I press on, that I may lay hold of that for which Christ Jesus has also laid hold of me.
verses.textEnNlt: I don’t mean to say that I have already achieved these things or that I have already reached perfection. But I press on to possess that perfection for which Christ Jesus first possessed me.
verses.textEnNasb: Not that I have already grasped it all or have already become perfect, but I press on if I may also take hold of that for which I was even taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already arrived at my goal, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我不以为自己已经得着了，我只有一件事，就是忘记背后，努力前面的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我不以为自己已经得着了，我只有一件事，就是忘记背后，努力前面的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我不是以为自己已经得着了；我只有一件事，就是忘记背后，努力面前的，
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,
verses.textEnEsv: Brothers, I do not consider that I have made it my own. But one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead,
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, I do not count myself to have apprehended; but one thing Ido, forgetting those things which are behind and reaching forward to those things which are ahead,
verses.textEnNlt: No, dear brothers and sisters, I have not achieved it, but I focus on this one thing: Forgetting the past and looking forward to what lies ahead,
verses.textEnNasb: Brothers and sisters, I do not regard myself as having taken hold of it yet; but one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and reaching forward to what lies ahead,
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,

verses.textZh: 向着目标竭力追求，为要得着神在基督耶稣里召我往上去得的奖赏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 向着目标竭力追求，为要得着神在基督耶稣里召我往上去得的奖赏。
verses.textZhCuv: 向着标竿直跑，要得神在基督耶稣里从上面召我来得的奖赏。
verses.textEnNiv: I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: I press toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: I press on to reach the end of the race and receive the heavenly prize for which God, through Christ Jesus, is calling us.
verses.textEnNasb: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们中间凡是成熟的人，都应当这样思想。即使你们不是这样思想，神也会把这事指示你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们中间凡是成熟的人，都应当这样思想。即使你们不是这样思想，神也会把这事指示你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我们中间，凡是完全人总要存这样的心；若在什么事上存别样的心，神也必以此指示你们。
verses.textEnNiv: All of us, then, who are mature should take such a view of things. And if on some point you think differently, that too God will make clear to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Let those of us who are mature think this way, and if in anything you think otherwise, God will reveal that also to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let us, as many as are mature, have this mind; and if in anything you think otherwise, God will reveal even this to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Let all who are spiritually mature agree on these things. If you disagree on some point, I believe God will make it plain to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, all who are mature, let’s have this attitude; and if in anything you have a different attitude, God will reveal that to you as well;
verses.textEn: All of us, then, who are mature should take such a view of things. And if on some point you think differently, that too God will make clear to you.

verses.textZh: 不过，我们到了甚么程度，就要照着甚么程度去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，我们到了甚么程度，就要照着甚么程度去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我们到了什么地步，就当照着什么地步行。
verses.textEnNiv: Only let us live up to what we have already attained.
verses.textEnEsv: Only let us hold true to what we have attained.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless, to thedegree that we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us be of the same mind.
verses.textEnNlt: But we must hold on to the progress we have already made.
verses.textEnNasb: however, let’s keep living by that same standard to which we have attained.
verses.textEn: Only let us live up to what we have already attained.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们要一同效法我，也要留意那些照着我们给你们的榜样而行的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们要一同效法我，也要留意那些照着我们给你们的榜样而行的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们要一同效法我，也当留意看那些照我们榜样行的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Join together in following my example, brothers and sisters, and just as you have us as a model, keep your eyes on those who live as we do.
verses.textEnEsv: Brothers, join in imitating me, and keep your eyes on those who walk according to the example you have in us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, join in following my example, and note those who so walk, as you have us for a pattern.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, pattern your lives after mine, and learn from those who follow our example.
verses.textEnNasb: Brothers and sisters, join in following my example, and observe those who walk according to the pattern you have in us.
verses.textEn: Join together in following my example, brothers and sisters, and just as you have us as a model, keep your eyes on those who live as we do.

verses.textZh: 我常常告诉你们，现在又流着泪说，有许多人行事为人，是基督十字架的仇敌，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我常常告诉你们，现在又流着泪说，有许多人行事为人，是基督十字架的仇敌，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有许多人行事是基督十字架的仇敌。我屡次告诉你们，现在又流泪地告诉你们：
verses.textEnNiv: For, as I have often told you before and now tell you again even with tears, many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For many, of whom I have often told you and now tell you even with tears, walk as enemies of the cross of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, thattheyare the enemies of the cross of Christ:
verses.textEnNlt: For I have told you often before, and I say it again with tears in my eyes, that there are many whose conduct shows they are really enemies of the cross of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For many walk, of whom I often told you, and now tell you even as I weep, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ,
verses.textEn: For, as I have often told you before and now tell you again even with tears, many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.

verses.textZh: 他们的结局是灭亡，他们的神是自己的肚腹，他们以自己的羞辱为荣耀，所思想的都是地上的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的结局是灭亡，他们的神是自己的肚腹，他们以自己的羞辱为荣耀，所思想的都是地上的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的结局就是沉沦；他们的神就是自己的肚腹。他们以自己的羞辱为荣耀，专以地上的事为念。
verses.textEnNiv: Their destiny is destruction, their god is their stomach, and their glory is in their shame. Their mind is set on earthly things.
verses.textEnEsv: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and they glory in their shame, with minds set on earthly things.
verses.textEnNkjv: whose end is destruction, whose god istheir belly, and whose glory is in their shame— who set their mind on earthly things.
verses.textEnNlt: They are headed for destruction. Their god is their appetite, they brag about shameful things, and they think only about this life here on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: whose end is destruction, whose god is their appetite, and whose glory is in their shame, who have their minds on earthly things.
verses.textEn: Their destiny is destruction, their god is their stomach, and their glory is in their shame. Their mind is set on earthly things.

verses.textZh: 但我们是天上的公民，切望救主，就是主耶稣基督，从天上降临；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我们是天上的公民，切望救主，就是主耶稣基督，从天上降临；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们却是天上的国民，并且等候救主，就是主耶稣基督从天上降临。
verses.textEnNiv: But our citizenship is in heaven. And we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: But our citizenship is in heaven, and from it we await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: For our citizenship is in heaven, from which we also eagerly wait for the Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: But we are citizens of heaven, where the Lord Jesus Christ lives. And we are eagerly waiting for him to return as our Savior.
verses.textEnNasb: For our citizenship is in heaven, from which we also eagerly wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.textEn: But our citizenship is in heaven. And we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.textZh: 他要运用那使万有归服自己的大能，改变我们这卑贱的身体，和他荣耀的身体相似。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要运用那使万有归服自己的大能，改变我们这卑贱的身体，和他荣耀的身体相似。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要按着那能叫万有归服自己的大能，将我们这卑贱的身体改变形状，和他自己荣耀的身体相似。
verses.textEnNiv: who, by the power that enables him to bring everything under his control, will transform our lowly bodies so that they will be like his glorious body.
verses.textEnEsv: who will transform our lowly body to be like his glorious body, by the power that enables him even to subject all things to himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: who will transform our lowly body that it may be conformed to His glorious body, according to the working by which He is able even to subdue all things to Himself.
verses.textEnNlt: He will take our weak mortal bodies and change them into glorious bodies like his own, using the same power with which he will bring everything under his control.
verses.textEnNasb: who will transform the body of our lowly condition into conformity with His glorious body, by the exertion of the power that He has even to subject all things to Himself.
verses.textEn: who, by the power that enables him to bring everything under his control, will transform our lowly bodies so that they will be like his glorious body.

verses.textZh: 我所想念亲爱的弟兄们，你们就是我的喜乐、我的冠冕。所以，亲爱的，你们应当靠着主站立得稳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所想念亲爱的弟兄们，你们就是我的喜乐、我的冠冕。所以，亲爱的，你们应当靠着主站立得稳。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所亲爱、所想念的弟兄们，你们就是我的喜乐，我的冠冕。我亲爱的弟兄，你们应当靠主站立得稳。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, you whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, dear friends!
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, stand firm thus in the Lord, my beloved.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, my beloved and longed-for brethren, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, beloved.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stay true to the Lord. I love you and long to see you, dear friends, for you are my joy and the crown I receive for my work.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, my beloved brothers and sisters, whom I long to see, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
verses.textEn: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, you whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, dear friends!

verses.textZh: 我劝友阿嫡，也劝循都基，要在主里有同样的思想。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我劝友阿嫡，也劝循都基，要在主里有同样的思想。
verses.textZhCuv: 我劝友阿蝶和循都基，要在主里同心。
verses.textEnNiv: I plead with Euodia and I plead with Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: I entreat Euodia and I entreat Syntyche to agree in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: I implore Euodia and I implore Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I appeal to Euodia and Syntyche. Please, because you belong to the Lord, settle your disagreement.
verses.textEnNasb: I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to live in harmony in the Lord.
verses.textEn: I plead with Euodia and I plead with Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 我真诚的同道啊，我也求你帮助她们。这两个女人，还有革利免和其余的同工，都跟我在福音的事工上一同劳苦，他们的名字都在生命册上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我真诚的同道啊，我也求你帮助她们。这两个女人，还有革利免和其余的同工，都跟我在福音的事工上一同劳苦，他们的名字都在生命册上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也求你这真实同负一轭的，帮助这两个女人，因为她们在福音上曾与我一同劳苦；还有革利免，并其余和我一同做工的，他们的名字都在生命册上。
verses.textEnNiv: Yes, and I ask you, my true companion, help these women since they have contended at my side in the cause of the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my co-workers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.textEnEsv: Yes, I ask you also, true companion, help these women, who have labored side by side with me in the gospel together with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I urge you also, true companion, help these women who labored with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
